tagline: Certified Humane Cage-Free Eggs from Vero Beach, Florida

why_choose_us.title: 48 hours, farm to truck
why_choose_us.description: Our eggs are laid, packed and shipped within 48 hours. No aggregation warehouse in the middle, no guessing how old a case is when it reaches you.

why_choose_us.title: One farm, not a blend
why_choose_us.description: Every case traces back to our farm on State Road 60. When a buyer asks where the eggs came from, there is one answer instead of a supplier list.

why_choose_us.title: Certified, then inspected
why_choose_us.description: Certified Humane is audited by third-party veterinarians and animal-welfare scientists. It is not a label we award ourselves, which is the difference between it and a plain cage-free claim.

why_choose_us.title: Built as a closed loop
why_choose_us.description: Solar power, reclaimed water, manure turned into fertiliser and egg wash water feeding hydroponics. Our BioCircular system is how the farm runs, not a page on the website.
